title: Deterministic TypeDoc API-reference extractor for @grafting/ui and @grafting/x6-canvas
objective: Owner-directed (research: open-source tools to feed Architecture Studio's future graph/docs/context surface; chosen first prototype: automatic documentation). Add TypeDoc as a deterministic extractor -- same shape as the existing graph:map/graph:manifest/graph:extract generators -- that produces a per-package JSON API model for @grafting/ui and @grafting/x6-canvas from their existing public-API entry points (src/index.ts, already governed by check-typescript-public-api.mjs), written to docs/generated/api/. No new app, no site, no hosting decision: this round is scoped to TypeDoc only, per the owner's explicit choice between 'TypeDoc only' and 'TypeDoc + Docusaurus'.
validations: pnpm view typedoc peerDependencies: confirmed typedoc@0.28.20 supports typescript 5.9.x, matching this repo's pinned 5.9.3 -- pinned exact (no caret), matching the repo's version-pin convention

node tools/scripts/generate-api-docs.mjs: generated docs/generated/api/ui.api.json and x6-canvas.api.json from each package's existing src/index.ts entry point with zero errors/warnings (fixed two real ones along the way: TypeDoc's glob matching rejects Windows backslash separators even on a Windows host, so entry/tsconfig/basePath are posix-ified; disableGit without disableSources produced a source-link warning, resolved by disabling sources entirely since JSON-only output was the explicit scope)
node tools/scripts/generate-api-docs.mjs --check: converges clean immediately after generation

Real drift proof (same pattern as I-004/I-007's own validations): hand-corrupted docs/generated/api/ui.api.json's top-level name field -> --check failed naming the stale file -> regenerated -> --check passed again
pnpm run docs:check: full six-step chain passes end to end, including the new docs:api:check step alongside the five pre-existing checks
pnpm exec nx run grafting:docs-api-check: the new root Nx target runs and passes directly, not just via the pnpm script
grep -c sources docs/generated/api/ui.api.json: 0 -- confirmed no absolute, machine-specific file paths leaked into the committed JSON

git status --short: only this task's declared affected_paths changed (plus pnpm-lock.yaml from the new typedoc devDependency), confirmed alongside other pre-existing uncommitted work from earlier in this session
artifacts: package.json (typedoc devDependency, docs:api:generate/docs:api:check scripts, docs:check now chains six steps)
tools/scripts/README.md (new section, plus docs:check step count corrected from five to six)
risks: TypeDoc output format/JSON schema is third-party and can change between major versions; the generator pins an exact TypeDoc version (matching this repo's no-caret pin convention) and a --check mode is added so drift is caught the same way graph:extract:check catches Graph IR drift.

Does not touch packages/ui/src or packages/x6-canvas/src -- only reads their existing tsconfig.json and public entry point (src/index.ts) already governed by check-typescript-public-api.mjs; no risk of colliding with other agents' in-progress edits inside those packages.

docs/research/architecture-studio-open-source-options.md's adoption checklist targets Studio-facing product dependencies (search, tracing, editing); this is repo dev-tooling analogous to the already-adopted graph:map/graph:manifest/graph:extract generators, so that catalog is intentionally left untouched.
